| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Recycler is authenticated and has an active session with role Recycler. **2\.** At least one Pending handover request addressed to the Recycler exists. **3\.** The Recycler is on the Handover Requests screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Accept:** The request status is set to Accepted, the collection time slot is locked, the User's contact details are revealed to the Recycler, and the User is notified with MSG-HND-02. **\- Reject:** The request status is set to Rejected with a recorded reason and the User is notified so that another facility can be chosen. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged and an informative error message is displayed to the Recycler. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **Accept Request NF-01:** The Recycler selects "Handover Requests". **NF-02:** The system displays the incoming requests (sender name, distance, waste category, estimated weight, proposed time, attached photos). **NF-03:** The Recycler selects a request to view its details. **NF-04:** The Recycler clicks "Accept". **NF-05:** The system updates the status to Accepted, locks the collection time slot, reveals the User's contact details, and then notifies the User (MSG-HND-02).   **Reject Request NF-04 (from NF-03):** The Recycler clicks "Reject". **NF-05:** The system displays a dialog to select a rejection reason. **NF-06:** The Recycler selects a reason and then clicks "Confirm Reject". **NF-07:** The system updates the status to Rejected, and then notifies the User. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-03, if the proposed time is inconvenient, the Recycler clicks "Message" to negotiate with the User before deciding (see Negotiate via Chatbox). |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05 (Reject), if the Recycler clicks "Cancel", the system closes the dialog and keeps the request in Pending status. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-05 (Accept), if the User has cancelled the request in the meantime, the system displays MSG-HND-05 and refreshes the request list. **EF-02:** At NF-07 (Reject), if no rejection reason is selected, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents submission. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Recycler's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Recycler to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-NEG-05:** The collection time slot becomes officially confirmed the moment the Recycler clicks "Accept" on the User's Handover Request — no separate confirmation step is needed. **BR-HND-02:** Handover status changes are one-way and permanent: Pending → (Negotiating) → Accepted → Scheduled → Completed, or terminal Rejected/Cancelled/Expired/Disputed. No status may revert. **BR-HND-03:** A Recycler can view and respond only to requests addressed to them. **BR-HND-08:** Full contact details are revealed only after a request is accepted. |  |  |

###  **3.4 Cancel Collection Appointment** {#3.4-cancel-collection-appointment}

| Primary Actor(s): | Recycler | Secondary Actor(s): | User |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated Recycler to cancel a previously accepted collection appointment because of an unexpected situation, recording a clear reason, in order to inform the User promptly. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Recycler is authenticated and has an active session with role Recycler. **2\.** The handover request is in Accepted or Scheduled status and has not been completed. **3\.** The Recycler is on the Collection Schedule screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The request status is set to Cancelled, the reason is recorded, and the User is notified with MSG-HND-05. A late cancellation is recorded when it falls within the configured period before the appointment. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the appointment remains unchanged and an informative error message is displayed to the Recycler. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Recycler goes to "Collection Schedule" and then selects the request to view its details. **NF-02:** The Recycler clicks "Cancel Appointment". **NF-03:** The system displays a warning dialog and requests a cancellation reason. **NF-04:** The Recycler selects a reason and then clicks "Confirm Cancel". **NF-05:** The system updates the status to Cancelled, notifies the User (MSG-HND-05), and then displays a success notification. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, if the Recycler only needs to change the collection time, the Recycler clicks "Message" to negotiate a new time (see Negotiate via Chatbox) instead of cancelling. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-04, if the Recycler clicks "Back", the system closes the dialog and the appointment remains unchanged. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if the cancellation is within {X} hours before the appointment time, the system displays MSG-HND-06 and records it as a late cancellation. **EF-02:** At NF-04, if no reason is selected, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents submission. **EF-03:** At NF-05, if the User has cancelled or completed the request in the meantime, the system notifies the Recycler and refreshes the schedule. **EF-04:** At any point, if the Recycler's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Recycler to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-HND-02:** Handover status changes are one-way and permanent: Pending → (Negotiating) → Accepted → Scheduled → Completed, or terminal Rejected/Cancelled/Expired/Disputed. No status may revert. **BR-HND-06:** Either party may cancel until the handover is Completed. Cancellations within {X} hours of a confirmed appointment are recorded as late cancellations. |  |  |

###  **3.5 Negotiate via Chatbox** {#3.5-negotiate-via-chatbox}

| Primary Actor(s): | User, Recycler | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows the User and the Recycler to exchange real-time messages and images, and to submit price or quantity counter-offers, within a specific handover request in order to clarify logistics, adjust the terms, or agree on an alternative collection time. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User or Recycler is authenticated and has an active session with the corresponding role. **2\.** A handover request exists between the User and the Recycler (Pending, Negotiating, Accepted, or Completed). **3\.** The User or Recycler is on the Request Detail screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** Messages and image attachments are delivered in real time and permanently stored in the communication log of the request. When a counter-offer is accepted, the agreed terms are stored as an immutable snapshot. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, undelivered messages are not persisted, and an in-line retry indicator is displayed. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The sender (User or Recycler) taps the "Chat / Message" icon on the Request Detail screen. **NF-02:** The system displays the chronological conversation history and the request summary. **NF-03:** The sender types a message or attaches an image, and then taps "Send". **NF-04:** The system validates the content, uploads the attachment to Cloudflare R2 storage, delivers the message in real time, stores it, and finally displays it with a timestamp. **NF-05:** The other party receives the message with an in-app alert (MSG-NEG-02) and can reply by repeating the same steps. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-03, the sender submits a structured price or quantity counter-offer; when the other party accepts it, the system registers the agreed terms and displays MSG-NEG-03. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-03, if the sender taps "Back", the system closes the chat view and returns to the Request Detail screen; the conversation history remains saved. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if the network connection drops, the system marks the message with a "Tap to retry" indicator and does not persist it. **EF-02:** At NF-03, if an attachment is in an unsupported format or exceeds the size limit, the system displays MSG-CLS-01 or MSG-CLS-02 and rejects the attachment. **EF-03:** At NF-03, if the message exceeds the maximum length, the system displays MSG-NTF-03 and prevents sending. **EF-04:** At AF-01, if the request is already Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled, or Expired, the system blocks the counter-offer while the chat remains available. **EF-05:** At any point, if the session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the sender to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-NEG-01:** Negotiation messages exist only within a specific handover request and are visible only to its User and Recycler (and assigned Staff during a dispute). The full message history is retained and never deleted, so it can serve as evidence if a dispute arises. **BR-NEG-02:** Making or changing a price/quantity offer is allowed only while the request is Pending or Negotiating, and is locked once it is Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled, or Expired. The chat channel itself stays open for both parties even after the handover is Completed. **BR-NEG-03:** Only the latest offer is valid; each counter-offer supersedes the previous one. Upon acceptance, the agreed terms (price, quantity, time) are stored as an immutable snapshot. **BR-NEG-04:** The User proposes their desired collection time slot directly inside the Handover Request when creating it. If the slot doesn't work for the Recycler, the two parties negotiate a new time through the chat. **BR-NEG-05:** The collection time slot becomes officially confirmed the moment the Recycler clicks "Accept" on the User's Handover Request — no separate confirmation step is needed. |  |  |

## **4\. Handover Completion & Rating** {#4.-handover-completion-&-rating}

### **4.1 Create Handover Receipt** {#4.1-create-handover-receipt}

| Primary Actor(s): | Recycler | Secondary Actor(s): | User |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated Recycler to record the actual collected weight, upload proof photos, and submit a digital handover receipt after the physical collection, in order to request the User's confirmation. Payment for the waste is settled directly between the two parties outside the system. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Recycler is authenticated and has an active session with role Recycler. **2\.** The handover request is in Accepted or Scheduled status and the waste has been weighed on site. **3\.** The Recycler is on the Request Detail screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The handover receipt is created with the confirmed weights and proof photos, the request status is set to Awaiting User Confirmation, and the User is notified to confirm the receipt. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the request status is retained, and an informative error message is displayed to the Recycler. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Recycler opens the request and then clicks "Create Handover Receipt". **NF-02:** The system displays the receipt form with the scrap list and weight inputs. **NF-03:** The Recycler enters the actual weight (kg) for each waste category, and then uploads the proof photos. **NF-04:** The system validates the inputs, calculates the total weight and reference value, and then displays a preview. **NF-05:** The Recycler verifies the figures with the User and then clicks "Submit Receipt". **NF-06:** The system saves the receipt, sets the request status to Awaiting User Confirmation, notifies the User, and then displays a success notification. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-03, if extra scrap items that were not listed in the request are present, the Recycler adds them from the Recycler's accepted catalog. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05, if the parties disagree, the Recycler clicks "Cancel", the receipt is not submitted, and the request status is retained. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if the actual weight deviates from the agreed weight by more than {X}%, the system displays MSG-HND-04. **EF-02:** At NF-04, if a required weight or proof photo is missing, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents submission. **EF-03:** At NF-03, if a proof photo is in an unsupported format or exceeds the size limit, the system displays MSG-CLS-01 or MSG-CLS-02 and rejects the photo. **EF-04:** At any point, if the Recycler's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Recycler to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-HND-04:** A handover is Completed only when the Recycler confirms with a handover photo and the User confirms the receipt. **BR-HND-05:** Final settlement uses the Recycler-confirmed actual quantity and the agreed unit price. If the actual quantity deviates from the agreed one by more than {X}%, the User may accept or raise a dispute before settlement. Payment of the settlement amount happens directly between the Recycler and the User (e.g., cash or bank transfer at the time of handover) — the system only records the figures, it does not process or hold the money. **BR-HND-07:** Once Completed, a transaction cannot be edited or deleted, only viewed. |  |  |

###  **4.2 Confirm Handover Receipt** {#4.2-confirm-handover-receipt}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): | Recycler |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to review the digital receipt created by the Recycler (measured weights, scale photos, unit prices, and total amount) and confirm it after receiving payment directly from the Recycler outside the system, in order to complete the transaction and earn Eco-points. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** The Recycler has submitted the handover receipt and the request is in Awaiting User Confirmation status. **3\.** The User is on the Receipt Confirmation screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The request status is set to Completed and the transaction is permanently locked. Eco-points are credited to both the User and the Recycler, the Recycler is notified, and the rating form for the Recycler is opened. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails or the receipt is disputed, the system data remains unchanged, the status is not changed, no points are awarded, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User receives a push notification or opens a request in "Awaiting Your Confirmation" status. **NF-02:** The system displays the digital receipt (actual weights, scale photos, agreed unit prices, total amount). **NF-03:** The User checks the recorded weights and photos against the goods handed over. **NF-04:** The User receives the payment directly from the Recycler (cash or direct bank transfer outside the platform). **NF-05:** The User taps "Confirm Receipt & Complete". **NF-06:** The system updates the status to Completed, credits Eco-points to the User and the Recycler (MSG-GAM-01), displays MSG-HND-03, and then opens the Rate Recycler form. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-03, if a weight discrepancy is found, the User requests a re-weighing or coordinates a receipt adjustment with the Recycler via Negotiate via Chatbox before confirming. **AF-02:** At NF-03, if an unresolved disagreement exists or the payment is withheld, the User taps "Dispute Receipt" and the system opens the Submit Complaint form. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05, if the User taps "Back" without confirming, the system returns to the request list and the request remains in Awaiting User Confirmation status. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-03, if the actual weight deviates from the agreed weight by more than {X}%, the system displays MSG-HND-04. **EF-02:** At NF-06, if the completion fails because of a network or system error, the receipt remains in Awaiting User Confirmation status and no points are awarded. **EF-03:** At NF-01, if the User neither confirms nor disputes the receipt within 48 hours, the scheduled background job automatically completes the receipt in accordance with the system policy. **EF-04:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-HND-04:** A handover is Completed only when the Recycler confirms with a handover photo and the User confirms the receipt. **BR-HND-05:** Final settlement uses the Recycler-confirmed actual quantity and the agreed unit price. If the actual quantity deviates from the agreed one by more than {X}%, the User may accept or raise a dispute before settlement. Payment of the settlement amount happens directly between the Recycler and the User (e.g., cash or bank transfer at the time of handover) — the system only records the figures, it does not process or hold the money. **BR-HND-07:** Once Completed, a transaction cannot be edited or deleted, only viewed. **BR-GAM-01:** Points are awarded only for verified events, such as a Completed handover (based on confirmed category and quantity) — credited to both the completing User and the completing Recycler — and only once per event per role. No points for cancelled/disputed transactions; points are reversed if a dispute outcome reverses the transaction. |  |  |

###  **4.3 Rate Recycler** {#4.3-rate-recycler}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to submit a 1 to 5 star rating and an optional review for a Recycler after a Completed handover, in order to give feedback on the service quality and help other Users choose reliable facilities. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** The related handover request is in Completed status. **3\.** The User is on the Rate Recycler form, opened after confirming the receipt or from the completed transaction in the transaction history. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The review is saved, the Recycler's average rating is recalculated immediately, and MSG-RVW-01 is displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the review is discarded, existing ratings are not affected, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The system displays the "Rate Recycler" form. **NF-02:** The User selects a star rating (1 to 5). **NF-03:** The User optionally enters feedback about punctuality, honesty in weighing, or professionalism. **NF-04:** The User taps "Submit Review". **NF-05:** The system validates the input, saves the review, recalculates the Recycler's average rating, displays MSG-RVW-01, and then closes the form. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-01, if a review already exists for the transaction, the system displays the submitted review in read-only mode and does not allow a new one. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-01, if the User taps "Skip", the system closes the form without saving any review. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if no star rating is selected, the system highlights the stars and prevents submission. **EF-02:** At NF-01, if the transaction is not in Completed status, the system blocks access and displays MSG-RVW-02. **EF-03:** At NF-05, if the review cannot be saved because of a system error, the system displays an error message and keeps the form data for retry. **EF-04:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-RVW-01:** A rating/review can be submitted only by a party of a Completed transaction, once per party per transaction, within {N} days after completion. **BR-RVW-02:** A rating is 1–5 stars with an optional comment. Once submitted, it cannot be edited, but the author may delete it entirely (see BR-RVW-03). **BR-RVW-03:** The review's author (User or Recycler, whichever submitted it) may delete their own review at any time; this is permanent and cannot be restored. Exception: Staff/Admin may hide or delete a review if it has been reported and found to violate community standards (e.g., offensive language, fabricated information). Aside from the author and Staff/Admin under this exception, no other party — including the one being rated — can delete or hide a review. The displayed average rating recalculates immediately after any deletion/hiding. |  |  |

## **5\. Complaint Resolution** {#5.-complaint-resolution}

### **5.1 Submit Complaint** {#5.1-submit-complaint}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): | Staff |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to file a formal complaint about a handover transaction (e.g., inaccurate weight, unpaid amount, misconduct) with a description and photo evidence, in order to start Staff arbitration. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** The handover request is in Completed status, or the User rejected the receipt during Confirm Handover Receipt. **3\.** The complaint window has not expired ({N} days after completion) and no unresolved complaint exists for the transaction. **4\.** The User is on the Transaction Details screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** A complaint ticket is created in Open status, the transaction is tagged "Under Dispute", and the complaint is routed to the Staff queue. MSG-DSP-01 is displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, no complaint is created, the transaction tag remains unchanged, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User taps "Submit Complaint" on the Transaction Details screen. **NF-02:** The system displays the complaint form with reason categories (Inaccurate Weight, Unpaid Amount, Misconduct, Other), a description field, and a photo evidence upload area. **NF-03:** The User selects a category, enters the incident description, attaches supporting photos, and then taps "Submit Complaint". **NF-04:** The system validates the data, creates the complaint ticket in Open status, tags the transaction "Under Dispute", routes it to the Staff queue, and then displays MSG-DSP-01. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** N/A |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-02, if the User taps "Cancel", the system closes the form and returns to the Transaction Details screen without creating a complaint. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if the reason category or description is missing, the system highlights the required fields and prevents submission. **EF-02:** At NF-01, if the complaint window ({N} days after completion) has expired, the system blocks the action and displays MSG-DSP-03. **EF-03:** At NF-01, if an open complaint already exists for the transaction, the system displays MSG-DSP-04 and navigates to the existing complaint. **EF-04:** At NF-03, if an attached photo is in an unsupported format or exceeds the size limit, the system displays MSG-CLS-01 or MSG-CLS-02 and rejects the photo. **EF-05:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-DSP-01:** Only a User or Recycler who is a party to the transaction can raise a dispute, within {N} days after completion, with at most one open dispute per transaction. **BR-DSP-02:** A dispute must include a reason category and a description; supporting photos are optional. **BR-DSP-04:** Only Staff can resolve a dispute, and every decision must record an outcome (e.g., the User should receive a full/partial refund from the Recycler, or the dispute is dismissed) and a rationale. Since payment happens directly between the two parties outside the system, the outcome is a binding recommendation communicated to both for them to carry out themselves — the system has no mechanism to automatically transfer or refund money. **BR-DSP-06:** Dispute data (messages, photos, transaction details) is accessible only to the two parties and the assigned Staff. |  |  |

###  **5.2 Handle Transaction Complaints** {#5.2-handle-transaction-complaints}

| Primary Actor(s): | Staff | Secondary Actor(s): | User, Recycler |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated Staff member to receive and mediate complaints about handover transactions (e.g., weight differences, no-shows), evaluate the evidence, and issue a binding recommendation, in order to resolve disputes fairly between the parties. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Staff is authenticated and has an active session with role Staff. **2\.** At least one complaint is waiting for resolution. **3\.** The Staff is on the Complaint Management screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The complaint is closed with a recorded outcome and rationale, both parties are notified with MSG-DSP-02, and the decision is recorded in the audit log. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the complaint remains open, and an informative error message is displayed to the Staff. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Staff selects "Transaction Complaints". **NF-02:** The system displays the list of complaints (ID, parties, type, time). **NF-03:** The Staff opens a complaint. **NF-04:** The system displays the evidence, the handover receipt, and the chat history. **NF-05:** The Staff evaluates the case and then selects a resolution (Accept / Reject). **NF-06:** The Staff enters the ruling summary and then clicks "Issue Conclusion". **NF-07:** The system validates the input, closes the complaint, writes an audit log entry, and then notifies both parties (MSG-DSP-02). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-05, if more information is required, the Staff updates the status to "Requesting More Info" and the system notifies the parties. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-04 or NF-06, if the Staff clicks "Back to List", the system returns to the complaint list without saving any decision. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if the ruling summary is blank, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents submission. **EF-02:** At NF-07, if the complaint has already been resolved by another Staff member, the system notifies the Staff and refreshes the list. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Staff's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Staff to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-DSP-04:** Only Staff can resolve a dispute, and every decision must record an outcome (e.g., the User should receive a full/partial refund from the Recycler, or the dispute is dismissed) and a rationale. Since payment happens directly between the two parties outside the system, the outcome is a binding recommendation communicated to both for them to carry out themselves — the system has no mechanism to automatically transfer or refund money. **BR-DSP-06:** Dispute data (messages, photos, transaction details) is accessible only to the two parties and the assigned Staff. **BR-GAM-01:** Points are awarded only for verified events, such as a Completed handover (based on confirmed category and quantity) — credited to both the completing User and the completing Recycler — and only once per event per role. No points for cancelled/disputed transactions; points are reversed if a dispute outcome reverses the transaction. **BR-ADM-05:** Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. |  |  |

## **6\. Gamification & Rewards** {#6.-gamification-&-rewards}

### **6.1 Daily Check-in** {#6.1-daily-check-in}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to check in once per day in order to earn Eco-points, maintain a consecutive-day streak, and receive streak bonuses. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** The User has not checked in today (the daily check-in resets at 00:00 ICT). **3\.** The User is on the Home dashboard. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** A daily check-in record is created, the User's point balance is credited, the streak count is updated, and MSG-GAM-08 is displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, no points are awarded, the streak is not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User opens the "Daily Check-in" widget on the Home dashboard. **NF-02:** The system displays the 7-day check-in calendar, the current streak count, and today's reward preview. **NF-03:** The User taps "Check-in Now". **NF-04:** The system verifies the eligibility, records the check-in, calculates the points (base reward plus streak bonus), credits the points to the User's balance, updates the streak, and then displays MSG-GAM-08. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, if the User missed the check-in yesterday, the system informs the User that the streak will restart from Day 1 before the check-in is performed. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-02, if the User closes the widget without tapping "Check-in Now", the system returns to the Home dashboard without creating a check-in record. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-03, if the User has already checked in today (e.g., a duplicate tap), the system disables the check-in button and displays a message that the User has already checked in today. **EF-02:** At NF-04, if the User has reached the daily point cap for non-transaction actions, the system displays MSG-GAM-05. **EF-03:** At NF-04, if a database write error occurs, the system rolls back the point credit and displays an error message. **EF-04:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-01:** Points are awarded only for verified events, such as a Completed handover (based on confirmed category and quantity) — credited to both the completing User and the completing Recycler — and only once per event per role. No points for cancelled/disputed transactions; points are reversed if a dispute outcome reverses the transaction. **BR-GAM-02:** Daily point-earning from non-transactional actions is capped at {N} per user/recycler. **BR-GAM-09:** Each User/Staff account may check in once per day. The reward points increase with the length of the consecutive-day streak, and the streak automatically resets to Day 1 if a day is missed. |  |  |

### **6.2 Staff Daily Check-in** {#6.2-staff-daily-check-in}

| Primary Actor(s): | Staff | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated Staff member to check in and check out once per day in order to log working hours and build an attendance streak. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Staff is authenticated and has an active session with role Staff. **2\.** The Staff has not checked in today. **3\.** The Staff is on the Staff Dashboard. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The shift start and end times are recorded, the working hours are calculated, and the attendance streak is updated. MSG-GAM-08 is displayed at check-in. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, no shift record is created or changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the Staff. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Staff views the "Shift Check-in" widget on the Staff Dashboard. **NF-02:** The system displays the current time and the "Check-in" button. **NF-03:** The Staff clicks "Check-in". **NF-04:** The system records the start time, updates the status, displays MSG-GAM-08, and then switches the button to "Check-out". **NF-05:** At the end of the working day, the Staff clicks "Check-out". **NF-06:** The system records the end time, calculates the working hours, and then marks the shift as complete. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, the Staff clicks "View History" to review the monthly attendance streaks. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** N/A |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-03, if the Staff has already checked in today, the system prevents a duplicate check-in and displays a message that the check-in has already been recorded. **EF-02:** At NF-05, if no check-in exists for the day, the system disables the check-out action. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Staff's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Staff to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-09:** Each User/Staff account may check in once per day. The reward points increase with the length of the consecutive-day streak, and the streak automatically resets to Day 1 if a day is missed. |  |  |

###  **6.3 Redeem Points for Gifts** {#6.3-redeem-points-for-gifts}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to redeem accumulated Eco-points for rewards in the Gift Store (e.g., e-vouchers, eco-friendly items) in order to benefit from the User's green activities. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** At least one active gift with available stock exists in the Gift Store. **3\.** The User is on the Gift Store screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The required points are deducted from the User's balance and the gift stock is reduced atomically. A redemption record is created and MSG-GAM-02 is displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the point balance and gift stock are not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User navigates to the "Gift Store" tab. **NF-02:** The system displays the current point balance and the reward catalog (image, name, point cost, stock). **NF-03:** The User selects a gift and then taps "Redeem Reward". **NF-04:** The system displays a confirmation dialog with the point cost and the remaining balance. **NF-05:** The User taps "Confirm Redemption". **NF-06:** The system validates the point balance and stock, deducts the points and reduces the stock in one atomic transaction, creates the redemption record, and then displays MSG-GAM-02. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, the User filters the rewards by type (e-vouchers or physical items) or sorts them by point cost. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-04, if the User taps "Cancel", the system closes the dialog without deducting any points. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if the point balance is insufficient, the system displays MSG-GAM-03 and halts the redemption. **EF-02:** At NF-06, if the gift has run out of stock in the meantime, the system displays MSG-GAM-04 and refreshes the catalog. **EF-03:** At NF-06, if the atomic transaction fails, the system rolls back all changes without deducting any points. **EF-04:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-03:** Point balance cannot be negative. A redemption deducts points and issues the voucher atomically. **BR-GAM-04:** A reward can be redeemed only while active and in stock; each redemption reduces stock atomically. **BR-GAM-05:** A voucher is single-use, bound to the redeeming account, and expires on its expiry date. |  |  |

###  **6.4 Upgrade Virtual Tree** {#6.4-upgrade-virtual-tree}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User to spend Eco-points to grow the User's Virtual Tree through its development stages in order to unlock environmental Eco Facts and achievement badges. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated and has an active session with role User. **2\.** The User's Virtual Tree has not reached the maximum level. **3\.** The User is on the Virtual Tree screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The upgrade points are deducted, the tree level increases by one, the corresponding Eco Fact is permanently unlocked, and MSG-GAM-06 and MSG-GAM-07 are displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the point balance and tree level are not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the User. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User selects the "My Garden / Virtual Tree" icon on the home screen. **NF-02:** The system displays the tree at its current level, the progress toward the next stage, the required upgrade points, and the current point balance. **NF-03:** The User taps "Water & Upgrade Tree". **NF-04:** The system displays the upgrade cost confirmation dialog. **NF-05:** The User taps "Confirm Upgrade". **NF-06:** The system verifies the point balance → deducts the points → raises the tree level by one → unlocks the corresponding Eco Fact → updates the tree graphic → displays MSG-GAM-06 and MSG-GAM-07. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, the User taps "Knowledge Library" to browse the Eco Facts that have already been unlocked without upgrading the tree. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-04, if the User taps "Later", the system closes the dialog without any change. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if the point balance is insufficient, the system displays MSG-GAM-03 and disables the upgrade button. **EF-02:** At NF-02, if the tree has reached the maximum level, the system hides the upgrade button and displays a message that the tree has reached full maturity. **EF-03:** At NF-06, if the level update fails because of a system error, the system preserves the User's points and displays an error message. **EF-04:** At any point, if the User's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-03:** Point balance cannot be negative. A redemption deducts points and issues the voucher atomically. **BR-GAM-06:** Virtual Tree stage progression is one-way. Care actions are limited to {N} per day; an unlocked Eco Fact stays unlocked. **BR-GAM-08:** Earning points and redeeming them for vouchers is available to both the User and Recycler roles. Virtual Tree care, Eco Facts, and the contribution leaderboard remain scoped to the User role only. |  |  |

###  **6.5 Manage Eco Fact Content** {#6.5-manage-eco-fact-content}

| Primary Actor(s): | Staff | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated Staff member to manage the environmental knowledge facts shown in the Virtual Tree feature and link them to the tree unlock levels, in order to keep the educational content accurate and engaging. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Staff is authenticated and has an active session with role Staff. **2\.** The Staff is on the Gamification Content Management screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- View:** The system displays the latest list of Eco Facts. **\- Add:** The new Eco Fact is saved and linked to the selected tree level. **\- Edit:** The updated Eco Fact content is saved and reflected immediately. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged and an informative error message is displayed to the Staff. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **View Eco Facts NF-01:** The Staff selects "Eco Fact Knowledge Base". **NF-02:** The system displays the list of Eco Facts (Code, Title, Tree Level, Date, Status).   **Add Eco Fact NF-03:** The Staff clicks "Add New Eco Fact". **NF-04:** The system displays the form (Title, Description, Image, Tree Level). **NF-05:** The Staff enters the data and selects the tree level, and then clicks "Save". **NF-06:** The system validates the input, saves the Eco Fact, and then refreshes the list.   **Edit Eco Fact NF-03 (from NF-02):** The Staff clicks "Edit" on an Eco Fact. **NF-04:** The system displays the form pre-filled with the current data. **NF-05:** The Staff edits the content and then clicks "Save Changes". **NF-06:** The system validates the input, updates the Eco Fact, and then refreshes the list. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, the Staff filters the Eco Facts by tree level. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05 (Add/Edit), if the Staff clicks "Cancel", the system discards the changes and returns to the list. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if a required field is missing, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents saving. **EF-02:** At NF-06, if a text field exceeds its maximum length, the system displays MSG-NTF-03 and prevents saving. **EF-03:** At NF-06, if the uploaded image is in an unsupported format or exceeds the size limit, the system displays MSG-CLS-01 or MSG-CLS-02 and rejects the image. **EF-04:** At any point, if the Staff's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Staff to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-06:** Virtual Tree stage progression is one-way. Care actions are limited to {N} per day; an unlocked Eco Fact stays unlocked. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. |  |  |

###  **6.6 Manage Gift Inventory** {#6.6-manage-gift-inventory}

| **Normal Flow:** | **View Inventory NF-01:** The Staff selects "Gift & Voucher Inventory". **NF-02:** The system displays the list of gifts (Name, Type, Points, Stock, Status).   **Add Gift NF-03:** The Staff clicks "Add New Gift". **NF-04:** The system displays the gift creation form. **NF-05:** The Staff enters the gift details and point cost → clicks "Save". **NF-06:** The system validates the input → saves the gift → refreshes the list.   **Restock / Suspend Gift NF-03 (from NF-02):** The Staff clicks "Edit" or "Restock" on a gift. **NF-04:** The system displays a dialog to add stock or toggle the gift status. **NF-05:** The Staff enters the quantity or selects the status → clicks "Update Inventory". **NF-06:** The system validates the input → updates the stock or status → refreshes the list. |  |  |

| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-04:** A reward can be redeemed only while active and in stock; each redemption reduces stock atomically. **BR-GAM-05:** A voucher is single-use, bound to the redeeming account, and expires on its expiry date. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. |  |  |

###  **6.7 Manage Gamification Config** {#6.7-manage-gamification-config}

| Primary Actor(s): | Admin | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authorized Admin to configure the gamification point rates per kilogram of waste, the daily non-transaction point cap, the daily check-in streak bonuses, and the Virtual Tree stage thresholds, in order to keep the reward system balanced and prevent point abuse. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Admin is authenticated and has an active session with role Admin. **2\.** The Admin has system configuration privileges and the Gamification module is enabled. **3\.** The Admin is on the Gamification Configuration screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The updated gamification rules are saved and take effect immediately for subsequent User activities. The action is recorded in the audit log. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the gamification parameters are not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the Admin. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Admin navigates to the "Gamification Configuration" section. **NF-02:** The system displays the current parameters (point rates per kg by waste type, daily non-transaction cap {N}, check-in streak multipliers, Virtual Tree stage threshold table). **NF-03:** The Admin adjusts the reward point values per recyclable material category. **NF-04:** The Admin configures the daily Virtual Tree care limit and maps the Eco Facts to the growth stages. **NF-05:** The Admin clicks "Save Configuration". **NF-06:** The system validates the values (points are non-negative and level thresholds are strictly increasing) → saves the configuration → writes an audit log entry → displays a success notification. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-05, if the Admin clicks "Reset to Defaults", the system asks for confirmation and restores the baseline parameters. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05, if the Admin clicks "Cancel" or navigates away, the system discards the unsaved changes. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if a point value is negative or the stage thresholds are not strictly increasing, the system highlights the invalid inputs and prevents saving. **EF-02:** At NF-05, if a non-Admin account attempts to change the configuration, the system denies the request and displays MSG-ADM-04. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Admin's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Admin to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-01:** Points are awarded only for verified events, such as a Completed handover (based on confirmed category and quantity) — credited to both the completing User and the completing Recycler — and only once per event per role. No points for cancelled/disputed transactions; points are reversed if a dispute outcome reverses the transaction. **BR-GAM-02:** Daily point-earning from non-transactional actions is capped at {N} per user/recycler. **BR-GAM-06:** Virtual Tree stage progression is one-way. Care actions are limited to {N} per day; an unlocked Eco Fact stays unlocked. **BR-GAM-08:** Earning points and redeeming them for vouchers is available to both the User and Recycler roles. Virtual Tree care, Eco Facts, and the contribution leaderboard remain scoped to the User role only. **BR-GAM-09:** Each User/Staff account may check in once per day. The reward points increase with the length of the consecutive-day streak, and the streak automatically resets to Day 1 if a day is missed. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. **BR-ADM-05:** Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. |  |  |

### **6.8 Configure Leaderboard Cycles** {#6.8-configure-leaderboard-cycles}

| Primary Actor(s): | Admin | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authorized Admin to configure the leaderboard calculation cycle (Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly) and the ranking criteria, in order to run a fair and consistent contribution ranking. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Admin is authenticated and has an active session with role Admin. **2\.** The Admin has leaderboard governance privileges. **3\.** The Admin is on the Leaderboard Configuration screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The leaderboard cycle and ranking criteria are updated and the scheduled aggregation job is synchronized. The action is recorded in the audit log. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the leaderboard configuration is not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the Admin. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Admin navigates to the "Leaderboard Cycles Configuration" page. **NF-02:** The system displays the active cycle mode (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly) and the current ranking metric. **NF-03:** The Admin selects the ranking metric (Total Recycled Waste Weight or Completed Handover Count without disputes). **NF-04:** The Admin chooses the evaluation cycle duration (Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly). **NF-05:** The Admin sets the top contributor spotlight option (only display names are shown). **NF-06:** The Admin clicks "Apply Settings". **NF-07:** The system validates the parameters (only Completed, non-disputed transactions are counted) → synchronizes the scheduled aggregation job → writes an audit log entry → displays a confirmation notification. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, if the Admin clicks "Trigger Recalculation Now", the system immediately recalculates the ranking from the completed records using the current criteria. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-06, if the Admin clicks "Cancel" or closes the settings window, the system discards the unsaved changes. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if a required setting (ranking metric or cycle) is not selected, the system highlights the missing field and prevents saving. **EF-02:** At NF-07, if the synchronization of the scheduled job fails, the system keeps the previous configuration and displays an error notification. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Admin's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Admin to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-GAM-07:** The leaderboard counts only Completed, non-disputed transactions per the metric Admin configures, and shows only display names. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. **BR-ADM-05:** Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. |  |  |

## **7\. In-System Services & Payments** {#7.-in-system-services-&-payments}

### **7.1 Purchase In-System Services via VietQR** {#7.1-purchase-in-system-services-via-vietqr}

| Primary Actor(s): | User, Recycler | Secondary Actor(s): | VietQR Service |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated User or Recycler to purchase in-system service packages (e.g., ad-free experience, Green Tick badge, map priority) by scanning a dynamic VietQR code, in order to activate the purchased privileges automatically after the payment is verified. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User or Recycler is authenticated and has an active session with the corresponding role. **2\.** The VietQR Service is operational. **3\.** The User or Recycler is on the Service Packages screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The payment order is verified as paid, the purchased service package is activated on the account, a confirmation is sent, and MSG-PAY-02 is displayed. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails or the payment window expires, the system data remains unchanged, no service is activated, the QR code is invalidated (MSG-PAY-03), and an informative message is displayed. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The User or Recycler selects "EcoLink Services". **NF-02:** The system displays the available packages (name, benefits, duration, price). **NF-03:** The User or Recycler selects a package → clicks "Register to Pay". **NF-04:** The system creates a service order with a unique reference code → requests a dynamic VietQR code from the VietQR Service → displays the QR code with a 15-minute countdown and MSG-PAY-01. **NF-05:** The User or Recycler scans the QR code with a banking application and authorizes the transfer. **NF-06:** The system receives the payment notification → validates the signature, the order reference, and the amount. **NF-07:** The system marks the order as Paid → activates the purchased package → displays MSG-PAY-02 → sends an in-app confirmation. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-04, if only one device is used, the User or Recycler taps "Save QR to Photos" or "Copy Bank Info & Memo" to complete the payment in the banking application. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-04, if the User or Recycler taps "Cancel Order", the system voids the pending order and the QR code, and returns to the package list without any charge. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-04, if the 15-minute countdown expires without a payment, the system disables the QR code and displays MSG-PAY-03. **EF-02:** At NF-06, if the transferred amount does not match the package price, the system does not activate the package and flags the order for review in Manage Financial Reconciliation. **EF-03:** At NF-04, if the VietQR Service does not respond within 10 seconds, the system displays an error message that the payment gateway is temporarily unavailable and suggests retrying later. **EF-04:** At any point, if the session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the User or Recycler to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-PAY-01:** Payments for in-system services (e.g., ad removal, verified badges, feature upgrades) are processed through dynamic VietQR codes linked to a unique order reference and are marked successful only after a verified payment confirmation (valid signature and matching amount). **BR-PAY-02:** In-system payment events are handled idempotently, so that each VietQR payment is credited and activated exactly once. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. |  |  |

###  **7.2 Configure Transaction Fee** {#7.2-configure-transaction-fee}

| Primary Actor(s): | Admin | Secondary Actor(s): |   |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authorized Admin to configure the VietQR pricing and fee schedule of the in-system upgrade services (e.g., ad removal, verified badge), in order to control the prices applied to future purchases. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Admin is authenticated and has an active session with role Admin. **2\.** The Admin has financial policy privileges. **3\.** The Admin is on the Service Fee & Upgrade Pricing screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The updated service package pricing is saved and applied to future purchases. The action is recorded in the audit log. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the active pricing is not changed, and an informative error message is displayed to the Admin. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Admin navigates to the "Service Fee & Upgrade Pricing" screen. **NF-02:** The system displays the current service packages and their prices (e.g., Ad-free Package, Recycler Verified Badge, Premium Analytics Package). **NF-03:** The Admin selects a package → updates its fixed price (VND) or promotional rate. **NF-04:** The Admin sets the package validity (e.g., 30 days, 1 year, lifetime) and the effective date. **NF-05:** The Admin clicks "Save Fee Policy". **NF-06:** The system validates the values → saves the pricing → writes an audit log entry → displays a confirmation notification. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-03, the Admin clicks "Add New Package", enters the package name, promotional VietQR price, and benefits, and saves the new package. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05, if the Admin clicks "Cancel", the system discards the changes and restores the current pricing values. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-06, if the price is negative or exceeds the allowed maximum, the system highlights the invalid input and prevents saving. **EF-02:** At NF-05, if a non-Admin account attempts to change the pricing, the system denies the request and displays MSG-ADM-04. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Admin's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Admin to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-PAY-01:** Payments for in-system services (e.g., ad removal, verified badges, feature upgrades) are processed through dynamic VietQR codes linked to a unique order reference and are marked successful only after a verified payment confirmation (valid signature and matching amount). **BR-PAY-02:** In-system payment events are handled idempotently, so that each VietQR payment is credited and activated exactly once. **BR-ADM-02:** Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. **BR-ADM-05:** Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. |  |  |

###  **7.3 Manage Financial Reconciliation** {#7.3-manage-financial-reconciliation}

| Primary Actor(s): | Admin | Secondary Actor(s): | VietQR Service |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authorized Admin to monitor the in-system service payments made through dynamic VietQR and reconcile the revenue records of each period, in order to ensure accurate financial reporting. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Admin is authenticated and has an active session with role Admin. **2\.** The Admin has financial oversight privileges and service payments have been processed through VietQR. **3\.** The Admin is on the Financial Reconciliation & Revenue screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The reconciliation period is marked as Reconciled and its financial records are locked, and a reconciliation report is generated. The action is recorded in the audit log. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the period remains open for audit, and an informative error message is displayed to the Admin. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Admin navigates to the "Financial Reconciliation & Revenue" section. **NF-02:** The system displays the monthly reconciliation periods with the total VietQR transactions, successful payments, total service revenue, and pending transactions. **NF-03:** The Admin selects a reconciliation period. **NF-04:** The system displays the payment orders of the period (Order ID, account, purchased package, transaction reference, amount in VND, payment time, match status). **NF-05:** The Admin checks the transaction ledger against the bank statement → clicks "Confirm Reconciliation Period". **NF-06:** The system marks the period as Reconciled → locks its records against modification → writes an audit log entry → displays a confirmation message. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-04, if a transaction has a discrepancy (e.g., delayed notification or reference mismatch), the Admin clicks "Investigate Transaction" to view the payment notification log and manually re-verify the match. **AF-02:** At NF-04, the Admin clicks "Export Reconciliation Sheet" to download an Excel spreadsheet of the period. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-05, if the Admin leaves the reconciliation screen without confirming, the period remains open and no data is changed. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-05, if unmatched or pending payment orders remain in the period, the system displays a warning and requires them to be resolved before closing the period. **EF-02:** At NF-04, if the Admin attempts to modify or delete the records of a Reconciled period, the system blocks the action. **EF-03:** At any point, if the Admin's session has expired, the system displays MSG-NTF-01 and redirects the Admin to the Login page. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-PAY-01:** Payments for in-system services (e.g., ad removal, verified badges, feature upgrades) are processed through dynamic VietQR codes linked to a unique order reference and are marked successful only after a verified payment confirmation (valid signature and matching amount). **BR-PAY-02:** In-system payment events are handled idempotently, so that each VietQR payment is credited and activated exactly once. **BR-ADM-04:** Accounts with transaction history can only be deactivated, never deleted. **BR-ADM-05:** Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. |  |  |

## **8\. Account & Access Management** {#8.-account-&-access-management}

### **8.1 View Homepage** {#8.1-view-homepage}

| Primary Actor(s): | Guest | Secondary Actor(s): | N/A |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an unauthenticated visitor to access the public homepage, view platform highlights, browse feature overviews, read environmental articles, access public guides, and navigate to registration or login. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The visitor is not authenticated in the system. **2\.** The EcoLink web application is operational. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The public homepage layout, promotional banners, feature overviews, and public guides are rendered successfully. **\- Failure:** The system data remains unchanged, and an informative fallback notice is displayed if connectivity fails. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Guest accesses the website root URL. **NF-02:** The system retrieves dynamic platform highlights, active banners, featured eco-articles, and renders the Homepage layout. **NF-03:** The Guest browses the feature overview cards, public waste sorting guides, or FAQs. **NF-04:** The system displays the corresponding section details and educational media content. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-01, the Guest clicks "Sign In" or "Register" in the top navigation bar. The system redirects the Guest to the Login screen or Registration screen. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** N/A |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-01, if network connectivity drops or the application server is temporarily unreachable, the system displays a fallback static notice: "Service temporarily unavailable. Please retry later." |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-AUTH-08:** Access is role-based. Guests access only public information; each role accesses only its own functions and data. |  |  |

###  **8.2 Register as User** {#8.2-register-as-user}

| Primary Actor(s): | Guest | Secondary Actor(s): | Google OAuth, Gmail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an unauthenticated household citizen or individual to create a new personal User account using local email credentials or Google OAuth authentication, in order to participate in waste sorting and recycling handovers. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The Guest is not authenticated. **2\.** The Guest is on the User Registration screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** A new User account is created in the system with status Active (Google OAuth) or Pending\_Verification (local registration), and confirmation is displayed. **\- Failure:** Registration is halted, error notices are displayed, and no account record is created. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The Guest enters their Full Name, Email Address, Password, Confirm Password, and Phone Number → clicks "Create Account". **NF-02:** The system validates input formats, password strength (minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers), and uniqueness of the email address across all roles. **NF-03:** The system hashes the password using salted hashing, creates the account in Pending\_Verification status, dispatches a verification email via Gmail, and displays MSG-AUTH-08. **NF-04:** The Guest opens the verification email and clicks the activation link. **NF-05:** The system validates the token, activates the account (Active status), and displays MSG-AUTH-09. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-01, the Guest clicks "Continue with Google". The system redirects to the Google OAuth consent screen. The Guest authorizes access. The system validates the Google token and reads the email\_verified claim; if email\_verified is true, the system creates and activates the User account immediately, generates an active session, and redirects to the Homepage. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-01, if the Guest clicks "Already have an account? Sign In", the system cancels the registration flow and navigates to the Login screen. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-01, if the Guest leaves any required field blank, the system highlights the field and displays MSG-AUTH-02. **EF-02:** At NF-01, if any input exceeds the allowed character limit, the system displays MSG-NTF-03 under the field. **EF-03:** At NF-01, if the entered email is already registered to any User account, the system prevents submission and displays an in-line message: "This email address is already in use. Please sign in or use another email." **EF-04:** At AF-01, if Google returns email\_verified \= false, the system creates the account in Pending\_Verification status and requires the standard email verification flow before activation. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-AUTH-01:** One email address can be linked to only one account, across both roles (User/Recycler) and both sign-up methods (local/Google). **BR-AUTH-02:** During Google sign-in/sign-up, the system reads the email\_verified claim from Google's ID token/UserInfo response. If email\_verified \= true, the email is marked verified immediately with no separate verification step. If email\_verified \= false, the standard email-verification flow is required before the account is activated. **BR-AUTH-07:** Google sign-in requires the OAuth token to be verified with Google on every login. Accounts created via Google are bound to the verified Google email and default to the User role. **BR-AUTH-08:** Access is role-based. Guests access only public information; each role accesses only its own functions and data. **BR-NTF-03:** Notifications are sent only to the account's verified email; changing the email requires re-verification. |  |  |

###  **8.3  Apply for Recycler Upgrade**  {#8.3-apply-for-recycler-upgrade}

| Primary Actor(s): | User | Secondary Actor(s): | Cloud Object Storage, Gmail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows an authenticated citizen (User) to submit facility information, GPS location coordinates, accepted scrap categories, reference pricing, and legal business licenses/identity documents from within their Profile to apply for an upgrade to a verified Recycler partner role.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User is authenticated. **2\.** The User has navigated to Profile / Settings and opened the ‘Register as Recycler Partner’ screen.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** An upgrade application is submitted with status PENDING\_VERIFY; the User remains an active citizen User, and the facility location remains hidden from public search until verified. **\- Failure:** Registration is rejected, uploaded documents are discarded, and error notices are displayed.  |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The system auto-populates the registered Full Name, Email, and Phone number from the active User profile. The User inputs facility name, operating address, accepted scrap categories, reference price list, and operating hours. **NF-02:** The system verifies the format of the facility details and location coordinates. **NF-03:** The User uploads the business registration license / identity document photo and clicks "Submit Application". **NF-04:** The system validates file formats and sizes, uploads the documents to Cloud Object Storage, and saves the partner upgrade application in PENDING\_VERIFY status linked to the User ID. **NF-05:** The system dispatches an acknowledgment email to the applicant through Gmail and displays MSG-MTH-03. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-01, the User clicks “Detect Current Location”. The system requests browser GPS permissions, captures coordinates, and auto-populates the latitude and longitude fields.  |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-01, if the User clicks "Cancel", the system discards all entered form data and navigates back to the Homepage.  |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-01, if the User already holds an active application in PENDING\_VERIFY status, the system prevents duplicate submission and informs the User that their upgrade application is currently under review. **EF-02:** At NF-01, if any required field is left empty, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 under the field. **EF-03:** At NF-03, if an uploaded file is not a supported image format (JPG or PNG), the system displays MSG-CLS-01. **EF-04:** At NF-03, if an uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size, the system displays MSG-CLS-02. **EF-05:** At NF-03, if the applicant submits without selecting at least one accepted waste category or providing a valid location, the system displays MSG-MTH-06.  |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-AUTH-01:** One email address can be linked to only one account, across both roles (User/Recycler) and both sign-up methods (local/Google). **BR-MTH-01:** A Recycler must be approved by Staff before appearing in search results or receiving handover requests. **BR-MTH-03:** A Recycler profile can be published only with at least one accepted waste category, collection conditions, and a valid location. **BR-NTF-03:** Notifications are sent only to the account's verified email; changing the email requires re-verification.  |  |  |

 

### **8.4 Login System** {#8.4-login-system}

| Primary Actor(s): | System User  | Secondary Actor(s): | Google OAuth |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Authenticates a registered user (User, Recycler, Staff, Admin) using email and password credentials or Google Single Sign-On, establishes an active authenticated session, and redirects the user to their role-specific workspace. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The user has an existing account in the system. **2\.** The System User  is on the Login screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The user identity is verified, an authenticated session and JWT tokens are created, and the user is redirected to their role dashboard. **\- Failure:** Authentication is denied, no session is established, and a generic security error message is displayed. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The System User navigates to the Login screen. **NF-02:** The System User  enters their registered email and password , clicks "Sign In". **NF-03:** The system verifies credentials, checks account status (must be Active), generates JWT access/refresh tokens, and establishes the user session. **NF-04:** The system redirects the authenticated user to their role-specific landing page (Homepage for User, Facility Portal for Recycler, Operations Workspace for Staff, Admin Dashboard for Admin). |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-02, the System User clicks "Sign in with Google". The system authenticates the OAuth token directly with Google, confirms email\_verified \= true, verifies account status, creates the session, and redirects to the appropriate dashboard. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-02, the System User clicks "Forgot Password?" → the system navigates to the Reset Password screen. **ETF-02:** At NF-02, the System User  clicks "Register" → the system navigates to the User  Registration screen. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-02, if the email or password field is left empty, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 under the field. **EF-02:** At NF-02, if the credentials are invalid or the account does not exist, the system displays a generic in-line message MSG-AUTH-01 (without disclosing whether the email or password was wrong). **EF-03:** At NF-02, if the account status is Deactivated or Suspended, the system rejects the login attempt, invalidates any existing sessions immediately, and displays MSG-AUTH-04. **EF-04:** At NF-02, if {N} consecutive failed login attempts occur, the system temporarily locks the account for {M} minutes and displays MSG-AUTH-03. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-AUTH-03:** When a sign-in fails, the message must not reveal whether the username exists or the password was wrong. **BR-AUTH-04:** After {N} consecutive failed sign-ins, the account is temporarily locked for {M} minutes. **BR-AUTH-05:** A deactivated or suspended account cannot sign in, regardless of password correctness, and all active sessions are invalidated immediately. **BR-AUTH-07:** Google sign-in requires the OAuth token to be verified with Google on every login. Accounts created via Google are bound to the verified Google email and default to the User role. **BR-AUTH-08:** Access is role-based. Guests access only public information; each role accesses only its own functions and data. |  |  |

 

### **8.5 Forgot Password** {#8.5-forgot-password}

| Primary Actor(s): | System User  | Secondary Actor(s): | Gmail |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Description:** | Allows a User or Recycler who has forgotten their password to request a secure one-time reset link by email and set a new password, in order to regain access to their account. |  |  |
| **Preconditions:** | **1\.** The User or Recycler has an existing account with a registered email address and is not signed in. **2\.** The email delivery service (Gmail) is operational. **3\.** The actor is on the Login / Forgot Password screen. |  |  |
| **Postconditions:** | **\- Success:** The new password is saved in hashed form, the reset link is invalidated, all existing sessions are invalidated, and the user is redirected to the Login screen. **\- Failure:** If any operation fails, the system data remains unchanged, the existing password is not changed, and an informative error message is displayed. |  |  |
| **Normal Flow:** | **NF-01:** The actor clicks "Forgot Password?" on the Login screen. **NF-02:** The system displays the email input form. **NF-03:** The actor enters their registered email → clicks "Send Request". **NF-04:** The system validates rate limits, generates a single-use token expiring in {X} minutes, dispatches a reset link by email via Gmail, and displays toast MSG-AUTH-05 (identical response whether or not the email exists). **NF-05:** The actor opens the email → clicks the reset link → the system validates the token and displays the New Password form. **NF-06:** The actor enters and confirms the new password → clicks "Confirm". **NF-07:** The system validates password complexity, updates the hashed password in the database, invalidates the token, revokes all current sessions, and redirects to the Login screen. |  |  |
| **Alternative Flow:** | **AF-01:** At NF-04, if the email is not received, the actor clicks "Resend" to request another link, subject to the rate limit. |  |  |
| **Extension Flow:** | **ETF-01:** At NF-02 or NF-06, if the actor clicks "Back to Login", the system terminates the reset process and returns to the Login screen without changing the password. |  |  |
| **Exceptions Flow:** | **EF-01:** At NF-03, if the email field is blank, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02 and prevents submission. **EF-02:** At NF-03, if requests exceed the rate limit ({N} per {X} minutes per email, or {M} per hour per IP), the system silently ignores excessive requests and displays MSG-AUTH-07. **EF-03:** At NF-05, if the link is invalid, expired, or already used, the system displays MSG-AUTH-06. **EF-04:** At NF-06, if the new password field is left empty, the system displays MSG-AUTH-02. **EF-05:** At NF-06, if the password does not meet complexity rules or confirmation does not match, the system displays an in-line validation error. **EF-06:** At NF-04, if the email cannot be delivered, the system logs the failure and retries without blocking the request. |  |  |
| **Business Rule** | **BR-AUTH-06:** A password-reset link is single-use and expires after {X} minutes. The response is identical whether or not the email exists. Resetting invalidates all existing sessions. **BR-AUTH-09:** A password-reset request for the same email is limited to {N} requests per {X} minutes, and requests from the same IP are limited to {M} per hour. Requests beyond the limit are silently ignored (the generic response is still shown). **BR-NTF-01:** Security and transactional emails (verification, password reset, dispute) cannot be disabled by the user. **BR-NTF-03:** Notifications are sent only to the account's verified email; changing the email requires re-verification. **BR-NTF-05:** Notifications must not contain sensitive data (full contact details, tokens), except one-time verification/reset links. **BR-NTF-06:** A failed email delivery is logged and retried up to {N} times, and never blocks or rolls back the business operation. |  |  |
