| **CLS** | AI Classification & Model Data | User, Staff | Waste image upload, AI result, misclassification feedback, error-image labeling, validation dataset |
| **SRT** | Sorting Guidance & Waste Catalog | User, Admin | Rule Engine lookup, waste search, QR scan, catalog and sorting guide updates |
| **MTH** | Recycler Profile & Matching | User, Recycler, Staff | GPS search, accepted categories, Recycler verification |
| **NEG** | Negotiation & Collection Time Slot | User, Recycler | Negotiation messages; collection time slot proposed inside the Handover Request |
| **HND** | Handover & Transaction | User, Recycler | Handover request (incl. proposed slot), accept/reject, receipt confirmation with photo, settlement (recorded only, no payment processing) |
| **PAY** | In-System Service Payment | User, Recycler, Admin, VietQR Service | Purchase of in-system service packages (ad-free, Green Tick badge, map priority) via dynamic VietQR, pricing/fee configuration, revenue reconciliation |
| **DSP** | Dispute Resolution | User, Recycler, Staff | Dispute report, Staff recommendation (no automatic refund mechanism) |
| **GAM** | Gamification & Rewards | User, Recycler, Staff, Admin | Points (User & Recycler), daily check-in (User/Staff), voucher redemption, Virtual Tree, Eco Facts, leaderboard |
| **RVW** | Rating, Review & Survey | User, Recycler, Staff | Partner rating (self-delete or Staff/Admin moderation), periodic service survey |
| **NTF** | Notification | All actors, Gmail | Email and in-app notifications |
| **ADM** | Administration, Reporting & Blog Approval | Admin, Staff | Staff accounts, account status, dashboard analytics, report export, blog post approval |

## **1\. Business Rules** {#1.-business-rules}

| BR-ID | Rule Statement | Applies To | Rationale | Enforced By |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **BR-AUTH-01** | One email address can be linked to only one account, across both roles (User/Recycler) and both sign-up methods (local/Google). | Registration | Prevents duplicate identities and ambiguous ownership of history. | The system automatically on every registration |
| **BR-AUTH-02** | During Google sign-in/sign-up, the system reads the \`email\_verified\` claim from Google's ID token/UserInfo response. If \`email\_verified \= true\`, the email is marked verified immediately with no separate verification step. If \`email\_verified \= false\`, the standard email-verification flow is required before the account is activated. | Registration, activation | Google reliably reports whether it has verified the user's email, so the system can trust this signal. | The system automatically on every Google sign-in/sign-up |
| **BR-AUTH-03** | When a sign-in fails, the message must not reveal whether the username exists or the password was wrong. | Sign-in | Prevents account enumeration. | The system automatically on every failed sign-in |
| **BR-AUTH-04** | After {N} consecutive failed sign-ins, the account is temporarily locked for {M} minutes. | Sign-in | Mitigates brute-force attacks. | The system automatically on every failed sign-in |
| **BR-AUTH-05** | A deactivated or suspended account cannot sign in, regardless of password correctness, and all active sessions are invalidated immediately. | Sign-in, all requests | Ensures banned/departed accounts lose access at once. | The system automatically on every sign-in and request |
| **BR-AUTH-06** | A password-reset link is single-use and expires after {X} minutes. The response is identical whether or not the email exists. Resetting invalidates all existing sessions. | Password reset | Prevents enumeration and token reuse/theft. | The system automatically on every reset request and use |
| **BR-AUTH-07** | Google sign-in requires the OAuth token to be verified with Google on every login. Accounts created via Google are bound to the verified Google email and default to the User role. | Google OAuth | Prevents forged tokens and role escalation at sign-up. | The system automatically on every OAuth login |
| **BR-AUTH-08** | Access is role-based. Guests access only public information; each role accesses only its own functions and data. | All views/requests | Enforces least privilege. | The system automatically on every request |
| **BR-AUTH-09** | A password-reset request for the same email is limited to {N} requests per {X} minutes, and requests from the same IP are limited to {M} per hour. Requests beyond the limit are silently ignored (the generic response is still shown). | Password reset | Prevents spam/abuse of the reset-email channel and protects the mail-sending quota. | The system automatically on every reset request |
| **BR-CLS-01** | Only images in supported formats (JPG/PNG) and within {X} MB are accepted. Invalid files are rejected before AI processing. | Waste image upload | Protects system resources and model input quality. | The system automatically on every upload |
| **BR-CLS-02** | An AI prediction is displayed only if it maps to an active category in the waste catalog. | AI classification result | Prevents wrong or unknown categories from producing incorrect guidance. | The system automatically on every classification |
| **BR-CLS-03** | If model confidence is below the threshold configured by Admin, the result is flagged "uncertain" and the user must confirm or choose the category manually. | AI classification result | Avoids presenting low-confidence predictions as fact. | The system automatically on every classification |
| **BR-CLS-04** | A user must confirm or correct the suggested category before the classification is recorded as final. | Classification confirmation | Ensures data quality and that the user acts on a verified category. | The system automatically on every scan |
| **BR-CLS-05** | Every misclassification report is linked to the original image, the predicted category, and the user-suggested category, and enters the Staff review queue. | Misclassification feedback | Creates a traceable feedback loop for model improvement. | The system automatically on every report |
| **BR-CLS-06** | Only Staff-reviewed and labeled images may be added to training/validation datasets. | Dataset management | Prevents noisy or malicious labels from degrading the model. | Staff review; the system blocks unreviewed data |
| **BR-CLS-07** | An image must not appear in both the training and validation datasets. Validation dataset changes are made by Staff only. | Validation dataset | Avoids data leakage and unreliable accuracy metrics. | The system automatically on every dataset update |
| **BR-CLS-08** | Waste images are accessible only to the owner, the Recycler in an active related handover, Staff reviewing feedback, and Admin. | Waste image access | Protects user privacy. | The system automatically on every image request |
| **BR-SRT-01** | Sorting guidance is served only from active rules in the Rule Engine, and each waste category has exactly one active guide version at a time. | Sorting guidance lookup | Guarantees consistent, unambiguous instructions. | The system automatically on every lookup |
| **BR-SRT-02** | Only Admin can create, edit, or retire catalog entries and sorting policies. Changes apply to new lookups only. | Waste catalog, sorting policy | Preserves history while keeping guidance current. | The system automatically on every catalog/policy change |
| **BR-SRT-03** | A sorting guide must contain at least one ordered handling step and a destination before it can be published. | Sorting guide publishing | Prevents incomplete instructions from reaching users. | The system automatically on every publish |
| **BR-SRT-04** | A category referenced by classification results, Recycler profiles, or transactions can only be deactivated, never deleted. | Waste category | Preserves referential integrity and historical records. | The system automatically on every delete attempt |
| **BR-SRT-05** | A scanned QR code must resolve to a valid EcoLink-issued target, and redirection is limited to internal EcoLink pages. | QR scan | Prevents malicious or external redirects. | The system automatically on every scan |
| **BR-MTH-01** | A Recycler must be approved by Staff before appearing in search results or receiving handover requests. | Recycler registration | Ensures partner legitimacy and safety. | The system automatically on every search |
| **BR-MTH-02** | A rejected verification must include a reason, and the Recycler may resubmit a corrected profile. | Recycler verification | Gives transparency and a path to correction. | The system automatically on every Staff decision |
| **BR-MTH-03** | A Recycler profile can be published only with at least one accepted waste category, collection conditions, and a valid location. | Recycler profile publishing | Prevents unusable listings. | The system automatically on every publish |
| **BR-MTH-04** | Search returns only approved, active Recyclers within the user's search radius that accept the identified waste category, sorted by distance by default. | Recycler search (PostGIS) | Keeps results relevant and actionable. | The system automatically on every search |
| **BR-MTH-05** | A user's GPS coordinates are used only to compute distance and never shown to Recyclers. The exact address is shared only after a request is accepted. | Location data | Protects user location privacy. | The system automatically on every search/profile view |
| **BR-MTH-06** | A suspended Recycler is hidden from search immediately, but existing active transactions remain visible to both parties. | Recycler visibility | Removes risky partners quickly without breaking in-flight deals. | The system automatically on every status change |
| **BR-MTH-07** | Removing an accepted category from a Recycler profile does not affect handover requests already accepted. | Recycler profile update | Protects users' agreed deals. | The system automatically on every profile update |
| **BR-NEG-01** | Negotiation messages exist only within a specific handover request and are visible only to its User and Recycler (and assigned Staff during a dispute). The full message history is retained and never deleted, so it can serve as evidence if a dispute arises. | Negotiation messages | Keeps deal discussions confidential while preserving a verifiable record for dispute resolution. | The system automatically on every message and retrieval |
| **BR-NEG-02** | Making or changing a price/quantity offer is allowed only while the request is Pending or Negotiating, and is locked once it is Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled, or Expired. The chat channel itself stays open for both parties even after the handover is Completed. | Negotiation offers and chat | Prevents changes to agreed terms while still letting users stay in touch after a deal. | The system automatically on every offer/message |
| **BR-NEG-03** | Only the latest offer is valid; each counter-offer supersedes the previous one. Upon acceptance, the agreed terms (price, quantity, time) are stored as an immutable snapshot. | Offers/counter-offers | Removes ambiguity about what was agreed. | The system automatically on every offer/acceptance |
| **BR-NEG-04** | The User proposes their desired collection time slot directly inside the Handover Request when creating it. If the slot doesn't work for the Recycler, the two parties negotiate a new time through the chat. | Time slot proposal | Aligns with the one-way Handover flow; removes the need for a separate appointment module. | The system automatically when the request is created |
| **BR-NEG-05** | The collection time slot becomes officially confirmed the moment the Recycler clicks "Accept" on the User's Handover Request — no separate confirmation step is needed. | Time slot confirmation | Aligns schedule confirmation with the Handover Request's own Accepted status. | The system automatically when the Recycler accepts the request |
| **BR-HND-01** | A handover request can be sent only to an approved, active Recycler that accepts the waste category in the request. | Handover request creation | Prevents requests that cannot be fulfilled. | The system automatically on every request |
| **BR-HND-02** | Handover status changes are one-way and permanent: Pending → (Negotiating) → Accepted → Scheduled → Completed, or terminal Rejected/Cancelled/Expired/Disputed. No status may revert. | Handover status | Maintains data integrity and audit trail. | The system automatically on every status change |
| **BR-HND-03** | A Recycler can view and respond only to requests addressed to them. | Handover request access | Maintains fairness and privacy between Recyclers. | The system automatically on every query |
| **BR-HND-04** | A handover is Completed only when the Recycler confirms with a handover photo and the User confirms the receipt. | Handover completion | Provides evidence and mutual agreement. | The system automatically on every completion attempt |
| **BR-HND-05** | Final settlement uses the Recycler-confirmed actual quantity and the agreed unit price. If the actual quantity deviates from the agreed one by more than {X}%, the User may accept or raise a dispute before settlement. Payment of the settlement amount happens directly between the Recycler and the User (e.g., cash or bank transfer at the time of handover) — the system only records the figures, it does not process or hold the money. | Settlement | Protects the User from unfair adjustments. | The system automatically at confirmation |
| **BR-HND-06** | Either party may cancel until the handover is Completed. Cancellations within {X} hours of a confirmed appointment are recorded as late cancellations. | Cancellation | Discourages no-shows while keeping cancellation possible. | The system automatically on every cancellation |
| **BR-HND-07** | Once Completed, a transaction cannot be edited or deleted, only viewed. | Transaction records | Preserves reliable history for reporting and disputes. | The system automatically after completion |
| **BR-HND-08** | Full contact details are revealed only after a request is accepted. | Contact visibility | Protects privacy until both parties commit. | The system automatically on every profile/request view |
| **BR-PAY-01** | Payments for in-system services (e.g., ad removal, verified badges, feature upgrades) by a User/Recycler are processed through dynamic VietQR codes linked to a unique order reference and are marked successful only after a verified payment confirmation (valid signature and matching amount). | EcoLink service payment | Ensures accurate, automatic and transparent upgrades of in-system packages/features. | The system automatically on every webhook received |
| **BR-PAY-02** | In-system payment events are handled idempotently, so that each VietQR payment is credited and activated exactly once. | In-system VietQR payment | Prevents duplicate processing. | The system automatically on every webhook received |
| **BR-DSP-01** | Only a User or Recycler who is a party to the transaction can raise a dispute, within {N} days after completion, with at most one open dispute per transaction. | Dispute creation | Prevents abuse and duplicate disputes. | The system automatically on every submission |
| **BR-DSP-02** | A dispute must include a reason category and a description; supporting photos are optional. | Dispute creation | Gives Staff enough information to decide. | The system automatically on every submission |
| **BR-DSP-04** | Only Staff can resolve a dispute, and every decision must record an outcome (e.g., the User should receive a full/partial refund from the Recycler, or the dispute is dismissed) and a rationale. Since payment happens directly between the two parties outside the system, the outcome is a binding recommendation communicated to both for them to carry out themselves — the system has no mechanism to automatically transfer or refund money. | Dispute resolution | Ensures accountable, explainable decisions even though the system doesn't process payments. | The system automatically records the decision Staff makes |
| **BR-DSP-06** | Dispute data (messages, photos, transaction details) is accessible only to the two parties and the assigned Staff. | Dispute data access | Protects confidentiality. | The system automatically on every request |
| **BR-GAM-01** | Points are awarded only for verified events, such as a Completed handover (based on confirmed category and quantity) — credited to both the completing User and the completing Recycler — and only once per event per role. No points for cancelled/disputed transactions; points are reversed if a dispute outcome reverses the transaction. | Point awarding | Prevents unearned or duplicated points. | The system automatically on every qualifying event |
| **BR-GAM-02** | Daily point-earning from non-transactional actions is capped at {N} per user/recycler. | Point awarding | Prevents point farming. | The system automatically on every award |
| **BR-GAM-03** | Point balance cannot be negative. A redemption deducts points and issues the voucher atomically. | Point redemption | Ensures consistency between points and vouchers. | The system automatically on every redemption |
| **BR-GAM-04** | A reward can be redeemed only while active and in stock; each redemption reduces stock atomically. | Reward inventory | Prevents over-redemption. | The system automatically on every redemption |
| **BR-GAM-05** | A voucher is single-use, bound to the redeeming account, and expires on its expiry date. | Voucher | Prevents resale, reuse, and stale vouchers. | The system automatically on every voucher use |
| **BR-GAM-06** | Virtual Tree stage progression is one-way. Care actions are limited to {N} per day; an unlocked Eco Fact stays unlocked. | Virtual Tree, Eco Facts | Keeps progression fair and consistent. | The system automatically on every care/unlock |
| **BR-GAM-07** | The leaderboard counts only Completed, non-disputed transactions per the metric Admin configures, and shows only display names. | Leaderboard | Ensures fair ranking and privacy. | The system automatically on every calculation |
| **BR-GAM-08** | Earning points and redeeming them for vouchers is available to both the User and Recycler roles. Virtual Tree care, Eco Facts, and the contribution leaderboard remain scoped to the User role only. | Gamification access | Rewards Recyclers who help complete trades, while keeping consumer-facing features for individual Users. | The system automatically runs whenever there's a request |
| **BR-GAM-09** | Each User/Staff account may check in once per day. The reward points increase with the length of the consecutive-day streak, and the streak automatically resets to Day 1 if a day is missed. | Daily check-in | Encourages consistent daily engagement (per use cases U-15, S-11). For Staff, the check-in includes check-in/check-out to log working hours and an attendance streak. | The system automatically runs every time attendance is taken |
| **BR-RVW-01** | A rating/review can be submitted only by a party of a Completed transaction, once per party per transaction, within {N} days after completion. | Rating submission | Prevents fake, duplicate, or retaliatory reviews. | The system automatically on every submission |
| **BR-RVW-02** | A rating is 1–5 stars with an optional comment. Once submitted, it cannot be edited, but the author may delete it entirely (see BR-RVW-03). | Rating content | Keeps posted content trustworthy while giving the author control to retract it. | The system automatically on every edit/delete attempt |
| **BR-RVW-03** | The review's author (User or Recycler, whichever submitted it) may delete their own review at any time; this is permanent and cannot be restored. Exception: Staff/Admin may hide or delete a review if it has been reported and found to violate community standards (e.g., offensive language, fabricated information). Aside from the author and Staff/Admin under this exception, no other party — including the one being rated — can delete or hide a review. The displayed average rating recalculates immediately after any deletion/hiding. | Rating deletion/hiding & display | Gives the author control over their own content and lets Staff/Admin moderate harmful content, without letting the rated party suppress unfavorable-but-legitimate feedback. | The system automatically on every deletion/recalculation; Staff/Admin act on a reported review |
| **BR-RVW-04** | Surveys are sent on Staff's schedule, only to accounts with at least one Completed transaction in the period, once per recipient per survey. | Periodic survey | Targets relevant respondents, avoids duplicates. | The system automatically each survey cycle |
| **BR-RVW-05** | Survey results shown to Staff/Admin are aggregated and never identify individual respondents. | Survey analytics | Encourages honest feedback. | The system automatically on every report |
| **BR-NTF-01** | Security and transactional emails (verification, password reset, dispute) cannot be disabled by the user. | Email notification | Ensures critical information always reaches the user. | The system automatically on every send |
| **BR-NTF-02** | Every status change of a handover or dispute notifies all affected parties. | Status notifications | Keeps all parties informed. | The system automatically on every status change |
| **BR-NTF-03** | Notifications are sent only to the account's verified email; changing the email requires re-verification. | Email delivery | Prevents notifications going to the wrong person. | The system automatically on every send |
| **BR-NTF-04** | Appointment reminders are sent {X} hours before the scheduled time. | Appointment reminder | Reduces no-shows. | The system automatically (scheduled job) |
| **BR-NTF-05** | Notifications must not contain sensitive data (full contact details, tokens), except one-time verification/reset links. | Notification content | Reduces data exposure through email. | The system automatically on every notification |
| **BR-NTF-06** | A failed email delivery is logged and retried up to {N} times, and never blocks or rolls back the business operation. | Email delivery | Keeps core flows reliable. | The system automatically on every failed send |
| **BR-ADM-01** | Staff and Admin accounts are created only by Admin, with no self-registration; Staff cannot create or modify Admin accounts. | Staff/Admin accounts | Prevents unauthorized privileged access. | The system automatically on every account creation |
| **BR-ADM-02** | Roles are separated: Admin handles policy, catalog, leaderboard configuration, Staff accounts, and reports. Staff handles disputes, labeling, verification, reward inventory, survey configuration, and account status. | Role permissions | Enforces separation of duties. | The system automatically on every action |
| **BR-ADM-03** | Staff may change User/Recycler account status only with a recorded reason, and cannot change Admin or other Staff accounts. | Account status | Ensures accountable moderation. | The system automatically on every status change |
| **BR-ADM-04** | Accounts with transaction history can only be deactivated, never deleted. | Account deletion | Preserves financial and audit history. | The system automatically on every delete attempt |
| **BR-ADM-05** | Every Admin/Staff action on configuration, account status, verification, and dispute decisions is recorded in an immutable audit log. | Audit trail | Provides accountability and traceability. | The system automatically on every action |
| **BR-ADM-06** | Exported reports contain aggregated or anonymized data by default, exclude personal contact details, and every export is logged. | Data report export | Protects personal data. | The system automatically on every export |
| **BR-ADM-07** | Dashboard analytics are calculated only from completed and confirmed data, and are read-only. | Dashboard Analytics | Ensures reliable metrics. | The system automatically on every analytics query |
| **BR-ADM-08** | A blog post authored by Staff must be in Draft or Pending\_Approval status. It is published publicly in the app only after Admin approves it (Approved status). If the Admin rejects it, the post returns to Draft with feedback notes for the Staff to revise; both decisions are audit-logged and the Staff is notified. | Blog content publishing | Ensures content is reviewed before reaching users (per use cases S-08, A-09). | The system automatically enforces the status gate; Admin makes the approval decision |
